description:
#### Fixed
- **Hidden tabs coming back, and the settings long-press going away, after a while.** On some
  Instagram 454 builds Oxbow attached to the wrong screen element instead of the bottom bar,
  so a hidden Reels tab could reappear and holding Home or Messages stopped opening the
  settings. Oxbow now finds the bottom bar reliably and follows it if Instagram rebuilds it.

---

Oxbow for Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 (patch bundle 1.3.2). Earlier patch bundles for this
version, and what they changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

- **oxbow.apk** replaces Instagram (uninstall Instagram first).
- **oxbow-clone.apk** installs next to Instagram.
- **patches-1.3.2.mpp**: patch Instagram yourself in [Morphe Manager](https://morphe.software): add the source `github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow`.

Obtainium: add `https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow` and set the APK filter to `oxbow\.apk$` or `oxbow-clone\.apk$`.
